items.source: Note: Consider the use of local JMS transactions instead. Simply switch the "sessionTransacted" flag to "true" in order to use a locally transacted JMS Session for the entire receive processing, including any Session operations performed by a SessionAwareMessageListener (for example, sending a response message). This allows for fully synchronized Spring transactions based on local JMS transactions, similar to what JmsTransactionManager provides. Check AbstractMessageListenerContainer's javadoc for a discussion of transaction choices and message redelivery scenarios.
items.translation: 注意：请考虑使用本地 JMS 事务。只需将 "sessionTransacted" 标志切换为 "true"，即可对整个接收处理过程（包括由 SessionAwareMessageListener 执行的任何 Session 操作，例如发送响应消息）使用本地事务 JMS Session。这使得基于本地 JMS 事务的 Spring 事务能够完全同步，类似于 JmsTransactionManager 所提供的功能。有关事务选择和消息重新投递场景的讨论，请查阅 AbstractMessageListenerContainer 的 javadoc。

items.source: Message receipt and listener execution can automatically be wrapped in transactions through passing a Spring PlatformTransactionManager into the "transactionManager" property. This will usually be a JtaTransactionManager in a Jakarta EE environment, in combination with a JTA-aware JMS ConnectionFactory obtained from JNDI (check your application server's documentation).
items.translation: 消息接收和监听器执行可以通过将 Spring `PlatformTransactionManager` 传入`"transactionManager"` 属性而自动包装在事务中。通常情况下，在 Jakarta EE 环境中，这将是 `JtaTransactionManager`，并结合从 JNDI 获取的 JTA 感知 JMS ConnectionFactory（请查阅您的应用服务器文档）。

items.source: Creates a JMS Connection, starts the Connection (if "autoStartup" hasn't been turned off), and calls AbstractJmsListeningContainer.doInitialize().
items.translation: 创建 JMS 连接，启动 `Connection`（如果未关闭"autoStartup"），并调用 AbstractJmsListeningContainer.doInitialize()。

items.source: This listener container variant is built for repeated polling attempts, each invoking the receiveAndExecute(Object, Session, MessageConsumer) method. The MessageConsumer used may be reobtained for each attempt or cached in between attempts; this is up to the concrete implementation. The receive timeout for each attempt can be configured through the "receiveTimeout" property.
items.translation: 该监听器容器变体专为重复轮询尝试而构建，每次尝试都会调用receiveAndExecute(Object, Session, MessageConsumer) 方法。所使用的 MessageConsumer 可在每次尝试之间重新获取或缓存；具体由具体实现决定。每次尝试的接收超时时间可通过"receiveTimeout" 属性进行配置。

items.source: This base class does not assume any specific mechanism for asynchronous execution of polling invokers. Check out DefaultMessageListenerContainer for a concrete implementation which is based on Spring's TaskExecutor abstraction, including dynamic scaling of concurrent consumers and automatic self recovery.
items.translation: 此基类不对轮询调用器的异步执行机制做出任何特定假设。请查看 DefaultMessageListenerContainer，它基于 Spring 的TaskExecutor抽象提供了具体实现，包括并发消费者的动态扩展和自动自我恢复。

items.source: Default is none, not performing any transactional wrapping. If specified, this will usually be a Spring JtaTransactionManager or one of its subclasses, in combination with a JTA-aware ConnectionFactory that this message listener container obtains its Connections from.
items.translation: 默认值为 none，不执行任何事务包装。如果指定了该值，通常这将是 Spring JtaTransactionManager 或其子类之一，并结合一个 JTA 感知的 ConnectionFactory，该消息监听器容器从其获取连接。

items.source: The underlying mechanism is based on standard JMS MessageConsumer handling, which is perfectly compatible with both native JMS and JMS in a Jakarta EE environment. Neither the JMS MessageConsumer.setMessageListener facility nor the JMS ServerSessionPool facility is required. A further advantage of this approach is full control over the listening process, allowing for custom scaling and throttling and of concurrent message processing (which is up to concrete subclasses).
items.translation: 底层机制基于标准的 JMS MessageConsumer 处理，与原生 JMS 以及 Jakarta EE 环境中的 JMS 完全兼容。既不需要 JMS MessageConsumer.setMessageListener 设施，也不需要 JMS ServerSessionPool 设施。这种方法的一个进一步优势是对监听过程拥有完全控制，允许进行自定义扩展和节流，以及对并发消息处理（由具体子类决定）。

items.source: Note that within a JTA transaction, the parameters passed to create(Queue/Topic)Session(boolean transacted, int acknowledgeMode) method are not taken into account. Depending on the Jakarta EE transaction context, the container makes its own decisions on these values. Analogously, these parameters are not taken into account within a locally managed transaction either, since the accessor operates on an existing JMS Session in this case.
items.translation: 请注意，在 JTA 事务中，传递给 `create(Queue/Topic)Session(boolean transacted, int acknowledgeMode)` 方法的参数不会被考虑。根据 Jakarta EE 事务上下文，容器会自行决定这些值。同样地，在本地管理的事务中也不会考虑这些参数，因为在此情况下访问器操作的是已存在的 JMS Session。

items.source: NOTE: This value needs to be smaller than the transaction timeout used by the transaction manager (in the appropriate unit, of course). 0 indicates no timeout at all; however, this is only feasible if not running within a transaction manager and generally discouraged since such a listener container cannot cleanly shut down. A negative value such as -1 indicates a no-wait receive operation.
items.translation: 注意： 此值必须小于事务管理器使用的事务超时时间（当然，需使用相应的单位）。0 表示完全没有超时；然而，这仅在不在事务管理器中运行时才可行，且通常不被推荐，因为此类监听器容器无法干净地关闭。负值（如 -1）表示非阻塞接收操作。

items.source:
Setting this flag to "true" will use a short local JMS transaction
when running outside a managed transaction, and a synchronized local
JMS transaction in case of a managed transaction (other than an XA
transaction) being present. This has the effect of a local JMS
transaction being managed alongside the main transaction (which might
be a native JDBC transaction), with the JMS transaction committing
right after the main transaction.
items.translation: 将此标志设置为 "true" 将在非托管事务环境中运行时使用短本地 JMS 事务，而在存在受管事务（非 XA 事务）的情况下使用同步的本地 JMS 事务。其效果是使本地 JMS 事务与主事务（可能是原生 JDBC 事务）一起进行管理，且 JMS 事务会在主事务提交后立即提交。

items.source: Specify the Spring PlatformTransactionManager to use for transactional wrapping of message receipt plus listener execution.
items.translation: 指定用于消息接收及监听器执行的事务包装的 Spring PlatformTransactionManager。

items.source: Specify the transaction timeout to use for transactional wrapping, in seconds. Default is none, using the transaction manager's default timeout.
items.translation: 指定用于事务包装的事务超时时间，单位为秒。默认值为无，使用事务管理器的默认超时时间。

items.source: Template method that gets called when no message has been received, before returning to the receive loop again. Allows subclasses to react to the event of no incoming message, for example marking the invoker as idle.
items.translation: 当没有收到消息时调用的模板方法，在返回到接收循环之前。允许子类对无传入消息的事件做出反应，例如将调用者标记为空闲。

items.source: The default receive timeout: 1000 ms = 1 second.
items.translation: 默认接收超时时间：1000 ms = 1 秒。

registering a MessageListener for the specified listener.

fetching all requires resources and invoking the listener.

items.source:
Execute the listener for a message received from the given consumer,
wrapping the entire operation in an external transaction if demanded.

items.source:
Specify the transaction name to use for transactional wrapping.
Default is the bean name of this listener container, if any.
items.translation: 指定用于事务包装的事务名称。默认值为该监听器容器的 Bean 名称（如果有的话）。

items.source:
This implementation checks whether the Session is externally synchronized.
In this case, the Session is not locally transacted, despite the listener
container's "sessionTransacted" flag being set to "true".
items.translation: 此实现会检查 Session 是否处于外部同步状态。在这种情况下，尽管监听器容器的"sessionTransacted"标志已设置为"true"，Session 仍不是本地事务性的。

items.source:
Determine whether to trigger a commit after no message has been received.
This is a good idea on any modern-day JMS provider.
items.translation: 确定在收到无消息后是否触发提交。在任何现代 JMS 提供程序中，这都是一个好主意。

items.source:
Template method that gets called right when a new message has been received,
before attempting to process it. Allows subclasses to react to the event
of an actual incoming message, for example adapting their consumer count.
items.translation: 在尝试处理新消息之前，当收到新消息时立即调用的模板方法。允许子类对实际传入消息的事件做出反应，例如调整其消费者数量。
